name: Rainbow Robotics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Rainbow Robotics Co.,Ltd., a professional technological mechatronics company, provides robotic system engineering technology. It manufactures mechanical and electronic parts. The company offers robots, robot parts, astronomy-related hardware, software, and related products. Its robots comprise RB5 series, a cooperative robot; RBM-S100, compact autonomous logistics robot; RB-Y1, a dual-arm mobile manipulator; Hubo-2 and DRC-Hubo, which are bipedal humanoid robots; and FX-2, a rideable and user-operated biped robot. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Daejeon, South Korea.
